from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys, hashlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'test/wsdl-interop'))
from lxml import etree
import corpus, contract, survey
from independent import SchemaJob, run
from test_type_identity import expanded_type
name='TypeSubstitutionUsingXsiType'
base=Path('/tmp/module-xml-wsdl-survey/databinding/examples/6/09')
record=next(r for r in corpus.read_manifest(Path('test/wsdl-interop/adjudication-report.json'))['cases'] if r['case']==name)
raw=(base/name/('echo'+name+'.wsdl')).read_bytes()
corpus.check_digest(raw, record['wsdl_sha256'], name)
schema=etree.fromstring(raw).find('{'+contract.WSDL+'}types/{'+contract.XSD+'}schema')
schema_bytes=etree.tostring(schema)
corpus.check_digest(schema_bytes,record['schemas']['inline']['sha256'],name+'/inline')
compiled=etree.XMLSchema(etree.fromstring(schema_bytes))
cases=[]; documents={}; hashes={name+'/wsdl':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
for version in ('11','12'):
    wsdl=raw.decode()
    if version=='12':
        wsdl=wsdl.replace('http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/','http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap12/')
    identity=contract.describe(etree.fromstring(wsdl.encode()))
    binding=identity['ports'][0]['binding']
    assert identity['bindings'][binding]['soap_version']==version
    messages=[]
    for file,info in record['messages'].items():
        if not file.endswith('soap'+version+'.xml'):
            continue
        data=(base/file).read_bytes()
        corpus.check_digest(data,info['sha256'],file)
        assert info['decision']['valid']
        payload=survey.payload(data,survey.parser(base))
        compiled.assertValid(payload)
        documents[file]=etree.tostring(payload)
        hashes[file]=info['sha256']
        messages.append({'file':file,'envelope':data.decode()})
    assert len(messages)==1
    cases.append({'name':name+'/'+version,'wsdl':wsdl,'binding':etree.QName(binding).localname,'operation':'echo'+name,'messages':messages})
Path('/tmp/wsdl-p5-05-w3c-input.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases))
proc=subprocess.run(['qore','-b','--enable-debug','/tmp/wsdl-p5-05-w3c.qr','/tmp/wsdl-p5-05-w3c-input.json'],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
assert proc.returncode==0 and not proc.stderr,(proc.returncode,proc.stderr,proc.stdout)
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in proc.stdout.splitlines()]
assert len(rows)==8
assert len({(r['case'],r['file'],r['copy'],r['response']) for r in rows})==8
ns=schema.get('targetNamespace')
for index,row in enumerate(rows):
    assert not row['native_error'] and not row['retained_error'],row
    for field in ('native_xml','retained_xml','retained'):
        tree=etree.fromstring(row[field].encode())
        if field!='retained':
            assert tree.tag=='{'+survey.SOAP_NAMESPACES[int(row['case'].endswith('/12'))]+'}Envelope'
            tree=tree.find('{*}Body')[0]
        compiled.assertValid(tree)
        parts=tree.find('{'+ns+'}assembly').findall('{'+ns+'}part')
        assert len(parts)==2
        assert [p.find('{'+ns+'}number').text for p in parts]==['p1','p2']
        assert parts[0].find('{'+ns+'}description') is None
        assert parts[1].find('{'+ns+'}description').text=='extended part'
        assert expanded_type(parts[1])==(ns,'Part2')
        documents[f'{index}/{field}']=etree.tostring(tree)
oracle=run([SchemaJob(name,survey.SOURCE+name+'/echo'+name+'.wsdl',schema_bytes,documents)])
for results in (oracle['schemas'],oracle['documents']):
    for key,value in results.items():
        assert value['ok'] and not value['warnings'],(key,value)
Path('/tmp/wsdl-p5-05-w3c-results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'hashes':hashes,'oracle':oracle},indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS: 8 actual-binding/direction/copy rows; 2 original inputs and 24 outputs independently valid with exact part values and selected type')
